query_text: (@Tag nvarchar(50))SELECT TOP (20) a.Id AS AnswerId, q.Id AS QuestionId, q.Title, a.Score, u.DisplayName FROM dbo.Posts q JOIN dbo.Posts a ON a.ParentId = q.Id LEFT JOIN dbo.Users u ON u.Id = a.OwnerU
(@Term nvarchar(100))SELECT TOP (50) p.Id, p.Title, p.Score, p.AnswerCount, p.CreationDate FROM dbo.Posts p WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1   AND p.Title LIKE N'%' + @Term + N'%' ORDER BY p.CreationDate DESC,

(@From datetime)SELECT CAST(p.CreationDate AS date) AS PostDate, COUNT(*) AS Posts FROM dbo.Posts p WHERE p.CreationDate >= @From   AND p.CreationDate <  DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @From) GROUP BY CAST(p.Creat
(@From datetime,@To datetime)SELECT TOP (20) p.OwnerUserId, u.DisplayName, COUNT(*) AS Answers, SUM(p.Score) AS TotalScore FROM dbo.Posts p JOIN dbo.Users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId WHERE p.PostTypeId
(@UserId int)SELECT TOP (10) p.Id, p.Title, p.Score, p.CreationDate FROM dbo.Posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = @UserId   AND p.PostTypeId = 1 ORDER BY p.Score DESC, p.Id DESC
(@PostId int)SELECT a.Id, a.Body, a.Score, a.CreationDate, u.DisplayName FROM dbo.Posts a LEFT JOIN dbo.Users u ON u.Id = a.OwnerUserId WHERE a.ParentId = @PostId ORDER BY a.Score DESC, a.Id

(@PostId int)SELECT v.VoteTypeId, vt.Name AS VoteType, COUNT(*) AS Votes FROM dbo.Votes v JOIN dbo.VoteTypes vt ON vt.Id = v.VoteTypeId WHERE v.PostId = @PostId GROUP BY v.VoteTypeId, vt.Name ORDER BY

(@PostId int,@UserId int,@VoteTypeId int)INSERT dbo.Votes (PostId, UserId, BountyAmount, VoteTypeId, CreationDate) VALUES (@PostId, @UserId, NULL, @VoteTypeId, SYSDATETIME())
(@PostId int)UPDATE dbo.Posts SET ViewCount = ViewCount + 1 WHERE Id = @PostId
(@PostId int,@VoteTypeId int)UPDATE dbo.Posts SET Score = Score + CASE @VoteTypeId WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END WHERE Id = @PostId   AND @VoteTypeId IN (2, 3)

(@UserId int)SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, u.Reputation, u.CreationDate, u.Location, u.Views, u.UpVotes, u.DownVotes FROM dbo.Users u WHERE u.Id = @UserId
